subject: mathematics
concept: Identifying basic 3D shapes (cube, sphere, cone, cylinder) in everyday objects
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student rotates and handles virtual 3D shape models to notice their faces and curves
exercise.pictorial: Student matches pictured everyday objects to their 3D shape name
exercise.abstract: Student names a 3D shape from a simple written or spoken description

misconception_flags: confuses 2D shape names with their related 3D shape (e.g. calls a cube a square)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
